# Exact versions for every `pip install` in the workflows (used as
#   pip install -c .github/pip-constraints.txt <packages>
# so each workflow still names only what it needs, and a package that is not
# requested is simply ignored).
#
# Why: the hourly forecast job installed whatever PyPI served that hour. A
# breaking release of any of these would have stopped the forecast with no
# code change on our side. These are the versions the runner resolved on
# 2026-11-24 (Python 3.12, manylinux x86_64) while every workflow was green.
#
# To bump: change a version here, dispatch forecast.yml and reference.yml, and
# keep the change only if both stay green. Resolve a fresh set with
#   python3 -m pip install --dry-run --ignore-installed --python-version 3.12 \
#     --implementation cp --abi cp312 --platform manylinux_2_28_x86_64 \
#     --only-binary=:all: --target /tmp/x --report - <packages>
#
# forecast.yml: duckdb pyshp eccodes        barcheck.yml: duckdb
# reference.yml: xlrd openpyxl duckdb timezonefinder
attrs==26.1.0
cffi==2.1.1
duckdb==2.0.1
eccodes==2.50.1
eccodeslib==2.50.0.34
eckitlib==2.5.0.34
et_xmlfile==2.0.0
findlibs==0.1.5
flatbuffers==25.12.19
numpy==2.5.5
openpyxl==3.1.5
pycparser==3.12
pyshp==3.1.9
timezonefinder==9.2.0
timezonefinder-data==4.2026.6
xlrd==2.0.2
